judgment.rationale: The submission matches the rubric. Unchanged child parts are 705,500 INR, local pack cost is 726,090 INR, and unit saving is 103,910 INR. It used the approved record-17 volume of 110,000 packs per year for 5 years and excluded the unapproved 150,000-pack draft. Annual savings of 11,430,100,000 INR (110,000 × 103,910) and five-year savings of 57,150,500,000 INR are arithmetically correct. The 12.52% reduction is also correct (103,910 / 830,000). Ownership is stated as 49:51 EvTronics:EV Batteries Inc. The brief does not claim full cell localisation. It states that imported child parts remain the dominant forex exposure and that assembly alone does not demonstrate full compliance. Policy phases are framed as scenario assumptions. It covers the partnership structure, sourcing model, benefits, risks, volumes, phased roadmap, and next steps. The only gap is that capex is unquantified, which is flagged openly and consistent with the source, since no capex figure was supplied. The brief is likely within the 2–3 page limit, and page count is outside this review.
